title: Which Premier League team should you support? Take our quiz to find out
content:
The World Cup may be about to end following more than five weeks of ceaseless excitement, incredible storylines and history-making performances, but if you are new to the sport and looking for your next fix then fear not: the English Premier League gets going again in just over a month.

It is the most popular season-long sporting competition in the world, with the division being watched, analysed and talked about across the planet.

So, if you’ve become hooked on soccer during this amazing World Cup you would be well served by tuning into the game in England too.

But who to support? Don’t worry, The Athletic has put together a quiz which will tell you exactly who you personally should be rooting for in English football this season. Enjoy!
